The said items were concurred in by the House.
It was agreed by unanimous consent to revert to the Order of 
Introduction of Bills.
The following Bills were introduced and read a first time.
By Hon. Greg Byrne, 
Bill 41,  Supplementary Appropriations Act 2008-2009 (2)
Bill 42,  Supplementary Appropriations Act 2009-2010 (1).
Mr. Speaker announced that pursuant to Standing Rule 42.3(1), 
Bills 41 and 42 were ordered for second and third reading 
forthwith.
The following Bills were read a second time:
Bill 41,  Supplementary Appropriations Act 2008-2009 (2).
Bill 42,  Supplementary Appropriations Act 2009-2010 (1).
The following Bills were read a third time and passed: 
Bill 41,  Supplementary Appropriations Act 2008-2009 (2).
Bill 42,  Supplementary Appropriations Act 2009-2010 (1).
